features.name: Project context and agent bootstrap
features.description: Initialize Obsidian project/decision records, PRODUCT.md, CodeGraph, and a restartable harness without claiming application behavior exists.
acceptance: All project commands run from gold-price-generator.
Product, state, progress, handoff, and startup artifacts contain actual project facts rather than template entries.
The real init.sh executes the installed harness validator and clearly distinguishes structural checks from application tests.
features.evidence: ./init.sh exited 0 with structural score 100/100 (all five subsystems 5/5); node --check scripts/verify-harness.mjs passed. CodeGraph full index and node lookup succeeded for the bootstrap adapter (1 file, 6 nodes, 5 edges). This is not application, OCR, test-suite, build, or deployment proof.

features.name: Real photo upload, local OCR, and source-price review
features.description: Decode a selected fixed-format JPEG/PNG/WebP, recognize the eleven price regions in a browser worker, and require review/correction without sample-price substitution.
features.blocker: The real upload/OCR/session API is verified; production review controls are being connected in feat-004.
acceptance: A new upload clears old prices and cannot receive stale results from an earlier OCR job.
OCR worker/model assets are pinned and self-hosted; photos remain in browser memory.
Unrecognized prices remain empty and editable; actual image recognition is demonstrated on the supplied photo.
features.evidence: Actual Chromium file selection recognized all eleven source prices and 2026-09-30. Startup cancellation, model 404 failure, recovery, same-origin asset requests, and empty native worker inventory were exercised. See docs/verification/2026-11-04-ocr-smoke.md.

features.name: Indonesian numeric entry and markup rules
features.description: Parse and format text-only rupiah/percentage inputs and calculate final prices from confirmed originals with per-row precedence.
features.blocker: Numeric domain is implemented; complete native input/UI integration and browser proof are pending.
acceptance: 1.000.000 is integer rupiah and 1,5 is a percentage, with useful caret/paste/delete behavior.
A row-specific rule, including zero, replaces global markup rather than stacking.
Recalculation always uses the original price; unsafe or invalid amounts cannot silently become a valid price.
features.evidence: Task 1: 43 domain/draft tests passed, TypeScript check passed, and a direct Node API smoke produced 1.624.000 for 1,5% and preserved 1.600.000 for an explicit zero override. Not yet marked complete because the actual editing interface is pending.

features.name: Source-preserving date and price rendering
features.description: Render reviewed prices and an optional Indonesian date at native source resolution, enforcing safe text regions and a readable font floor.
features.blocker: The renderer/PNG API is verified; production date/preview/export controls are being connected in feat-004.
acceptance: Decoded source pixels outside editable regions and original image dimensions remain unchanged.
Unchanged prices/date are not repainted; date is never silently replaced by today.
Long values fit without overlap, wrapping, clipping, or truncation, or export is explicitly blocked.
The downloaded PNG is opened and inspected; replacement font/background quality is a release gate.
features.evidence: Actual PNG downloaded/opened. No edits changed zero pixels; price/date edits changed zero pixels outside regions at 1024x1280 and 543x680. Actual OCR read intended PNG prices/date; long fit, unreadable block, and forced manual source correction passed. See docs/verification/2026-11-04-render-smoke.md.

features.name: Complete Indonesian mobile editing workflow
features.description: Connect upload, real recognition, source review, markup, date, preview, errors, and PNG download in a mobile-first React interface.
acceptance: Upload is prominent before a large preview; the complete workflow is exercised with a real file.
Controls have Indonesian labels, visible focus, local accessible errors, and real loading/disabled/error states.
360px, intermediate, and wide layouts have no horizontal overflow; form fonts are at least 16px and primary targets at least 44px.

features.name: Reviewed release, GitHub push, and Vercel preview
features.description: Complete behavioral checks, actual OCR/export smoke evidence, independent review, documentation, private GitHub publication, and Vercel preview when access permits.
features.blocker: Complete application verification and release review are pending.
acceptance: Pinned dependency install, checks, relevant tests, and production build pass without masking failures.
CodeGraph is refreshed against actual application source and agent continuity records contain observed evidence.
No secrets, local caches, sample-price fallback, or unfinished application paths are published.
A private blangkonsultan/gold-price-generator repository is pushed normally; Vercel status/URL is reported truthfully.
features.evidence: GitHub authentication was verified as blangkonsultan. No push or deployment has occurred; Vercel account/team API checks returned HTTP 403.
